svg.title: Gravity-drop mix-and-quench plunger, concept
svg.desc: Concept illustration, not the real device: a sample loop holding a tiny protein crystal hangs from a carriage on a slender vertical rail. It falls past a ligand spray nozzle, where the crystal turns amber as it is mixed, threads through two ring-shaped timing gates and plunges into a glass dewar of violet liquid nitrogen. A magnified inset shows the crystal passing through the spray; a thin timeline bar fills from mix to quench, tagged “< 10 ms”.
